member.summary: Where a compute module's resources sit in its descriptor set, as Source/Common/ComputeBindings.slang places them.
member.remarks: The engine's compute seam binds a resource by the number the shader declared it at AND by what kind it is: an image at slot zero and a storage buffer at slot zero are two different resources, because the dialect these shaders came from gives each kind its own numbering. member.name: T:OpenIGI.Shaders.ShaderModuleId
member.summary: The shader modules the library carries. One value per .slang source under Source/, whatever stages that source declares.

remarks.para: A hand-kept enumeration rather than a generated one, so a module is named in code the way any other constant is and a typo is a compile error. ShaderManifestTests pins it to the manifest and the manifest to the directory, so the three cannot drift apart: adding a .slang file without listing it, or listing one without a value here, fails the build.

A module is one source with all of its entry points, not one stage. That is how Slang compiles and how WebGPU binds — a shader module holds every entry point and a pipeline names the one it wants — and the Vulkan backend does the same rather than carry a second convention.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.Shaders.UpscaleRejectShadingVariants
member.summary: Chooses which compiled form of an adapter can run.

remarks.para: The pass tiles a five-stage chain of 3x3 filters through group-shared memory, and the tiles are the group plus an apron, so their cost grows with the group and not with the frame. At the preferred sixteen-wide group that is 46.5 KiB, which fits the 48 KiB a desktop adapter reports and does not fit the 32 KiB Metal allows. Exceeding the limit is not a slow path: pipeline creation fails outright, so the choice has to be made before the module is handed to the driver.

The two forms differ only in the define the build compiled them with. The measure is identical; the narrower group simply carries a worse apron ratio, loading a 20x20 tile to shade 64 pixels where the wider one loads 28x28 to shade 256.
